about: Prototype 11: Story Map 1 as nine puzzles, redesigned (GDD Edit 115, after the Edit 114 pressure test); snake order A1 B1 C1 C2 B2 A2 A3 B3 C3 (Edit 119). Set by hand. One learner: the LUMINARY™ SED-01-001, a sedan (the CEO car; Edit 120), rung 0 to 7 over the nine (puzzle 4 teaches roof lidar and street cameras together); certified, it returns on Map 2 as a drone car. Rungs: 0 blind, 1 forward camera, 2 side sensors, 3 roof lidar, 4 street cameras, 5 road items, 6 crash memory, 7 search. Kit: the parts issued for this test (battery1 dash, hands1 cones, knees1 Super Knees duck). Fleet: story.traffic.monument.<tile>; 0 clears every white car off the tile and its neighbours, decks included. Route: the red car's lane (duel.route, proposed). Layout (Edit 115): drop [x, y]; cones [] or [[x, y]...]; cover [{kind, at 0..1 along the route on screen, side left|right|N|S|E|W, gap from the kerb}]. Par and target in seconds (story.puzzle.par.<tile>, story.puzzle.target.<tile>, proposed). The traffic-light switch and the clients move to Map 2 (Parkland), with its new learner.

map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the Luminary™ learns. Certification is your goal.

learner.name: LUMINARY™
learner.source: NOX car classes (Lawrence, 9 Nov); liveries and the Map 3 class (Lawrence, 10 Nov); model ID, line, callsign and job from engine/p9/fleet.json (Style Guide V2 rule V7). Map 2: VANGUARD™ POL-01-001, white and black; Map 3: GENESIS™ SPT-01-001, red (Edit 121)

boss.text: Three pieces: a tall one no camera sees, a low one, and a tall one a street camera watches. A dash breaks the camera's post.

puzzles.name: First Contact
puzzles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your first colleague is keen and blind.
puzzles.twist: Walk into its side and the fault is yours: no points.
hints: It cannot see you. Be where it is going, and wait.
puzzles.solution: Stand in its lane; let it come.

puzzles.name: Stop Line
puzzles.new: Its forward camera. It stops for you in its lane.
puzzles.tale: Now it has eyes on its bonnet. It brakes for what it sees in time.
puzzles.twist: Stand in its lane: it stops at its line.
hints: It stops for what it sees in its lane. Step in when it can no longer stop.
puzzles.solution: Wait at the kerb; step in inside its stop line.

puzzles.name: High Road
puzzles.new: Its side sensors. It sees the kerb.
puzzles.tale: Now it watches both kerbs. The high road has a gap. Gravity is company policy.
puzzles.twist: Wait at the kerb: it sees you and stops short.
hints: It watches the kerbs, not the sky.
puzzles.solution: Escalator up to the high road; drop through the parapet gap as it passes under.

puzzles.name: Portal
puzzles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower. It cannot see through the kiosk.
puzzles.twist: From the open kerb: it sees you and stops short.
hints: Hide where its sensors cannot see. Step out just ahead of its nose.
puzzles.solution: Hide behind the kiosk; step out just ahead of its nose.

puzzles.name: CCTV
puzzles.new: Street cameras. A dash breaks a post.
puzzles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS. The street cameras watch the island.
puzzles.twist: Hide behind the cabinet: the camera tells the car.
hints: A dash breaks a camera post. Break it while the car is away.
puzzles.solution: Dash into the camera post between passes; then hide behind the cabinet; step out ahead of its nose.
puzzles.newLine: Street cameras · a dash breaks a post

puzzles.name: Swerve
puzzles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing. Today, cones only. It swerves round them.
puzzles.twist: No dash: it sees you at the kerb and stops short.
hints: A cone in its lane: it swerves. Be where the swerve goes.
puzzles.solution: Carry a cone into its lane; hide behind the kiosk; step into the other lane as it swerves.

puzzles.name: The Stacks
puzzles.new: Road items. It stops for cones.
puzzles.tale: The cubes rose one budget at a time. Now it stops for cones.
puzzles.twist: A cone in its lane: it stops now.
hints: Cones stop it. Cameras still break.
puzzles.solution: Break the camera between passes; hide behind the kiosk, one dash from its lane; dash as it nears.

puzzles.name: LED Canyon
puzzles.new: Super Knees: B crouches (keys: C). Press again to stand.
puzzles.tale: Two screens advertise all night. Low hedges line the canyon. Crouch behind them.
puzzles.twist: Hide behind the hedge standing: it sees you over it.
hints: Low cover hides you only if you are lower. Press B.
puzzles.solution: Crouch behind the hedge (B); dash out as it passes.

puzzles.name: Certification
puzzles.new: A boss. It learns between your hits.

objective.label: THREE HITS · A NEW WAY EACH

puzzles.tale: It has learned from every dummy so far. Three more lessons.
puzzles.twist: The same move twice: it remembers.
hints: A street camera tells it what it sees. Hide where the camera cannot look.
It remembers where you came from. Use a new spot.
A dash breaks a camera post. Then its cover is yours.
puzzles.solution: Hit 1 from the cabinet. Hit 2 crouched behind the hedge. Hit 3: break the camera, dash from the kiosk.
